title: Why you feel a sense of relief after crying
hook: Crying actually releases your body's stress hormones.

narration.text: Crying actually releases your body's stress hormones.
It is a natural, physiological response to emotional distress.
Emotional tears contain cortisol, a hormone linked to stress.
When you cry, your body expels some of these chemicals.
This process helps to rebalance your internal state.
That is why you often feel calmer and more relaxed afterwards.
It is not just a mental shift, but a physical one.
Have you noticed this feeling of relief yourself after a good cry?

description: Ever wondered why you feel better after a good cry? It is not just your imagination. Your body actually releases stress hormones through your tears, leading to a real sense of relief.
topic: Why you feel a sense of relief after crying, explaining the release of stress hormones.
